newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Seoul approves Pusan City Gas, three other IPOs.
newsitem.headline: Seoul approves Pusan City Gas, three other IPOs.

text.p: South Korea's Securities and Exchange Commission on Friday approved initial public offering (IPO) plans by Pusan City Gas Co and three other firms, the Securities Supervisory Board said.
The three others are Sewon Heavy Machinery Co Ltd, Duck Yang Industry Co Ltd and Kong Hwa Co Ltd.
Subscription is scheduled for May 26 and 27, with payment due by June 9, the board said in a statement.
Shares of these four companies are expected to be listed in the middle of June, it said.

Pusan City Gas, a city gas supplier in the nation's second-largest city of Pusan, plans to offer 2.7 million shares at 19,000 won per share. Yukong Ltd holds the largest single stake of 19.48 percent in Pusan City Gas.
Sewon Heavy, an industrial machinery manufacturer and an affiliate of Sewon Co, plans to offer 767,330 shares for 15,000 won per share.
Duck Yang plans to offer 420,000 shares for 19,000 won per share and Kong Hwa 292,800 shares at 20,000 won per share. Both are automobile parts makers.
